name: worker_auth

test_list.description: Generated 32-byte bearer credentials export exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal bytes and authenticate after explicit parent-controlled transfer.
Exactly one correctly formatted matching sensitive metadata value passes the tonic interceptor.
Missing, duplicate, malformed, wrong-length, and wrong-secret values are rejected without secret-bearing status text.
A credential for one worker cannot authenticate to a second worker authenticator.
Credential transfer writes to the caller-controlled channel and propagates output failure.
Compile-fail documentation checks ensure the bearer credential cannot be formatted through Debug or Display; no serde implementation is provided.

inputs.name: parent_secret
inputs.description: A parent-issued 64-byte lowercase hexadecimal value read from a controlled channel such as child stdin.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The outgoing worker request to authorize with one sensitive bearer metadata value.

inputs.name: incoming_metadata
inputs.description: Incoming request metadata that must contain exactly one valid matching token.

output_description: Client credentials attach a sensitive worker token; the server accepts only the matching token and returns a generic unauthenticated status for every rejected form. This authenticates caller to worker only; parent/client endpoint ownership, ACLs, and sandbox isolation are separate composition responsibilities.
